civilopediaText.text: Home to uncivilized barbarians, will spawn a hostile unit from time to time

name: Fossato difensivo
uniques: Can be built outside your borders

name: Barricata Tribale
uniques: Adjacent enemy units ending their turn take [10] damage
Will not be replaced by automated units

name: Avamposto
uniques: Adjacent enemy units ending their turn take [20] damage
Will not be replaced by automated units

name: Domu de Janas
uniques: Will not be replaced by automated units
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+20 Gold]

name: Nuraghe
uniques: Adjacent enemy units ending their turn take [30] damage
Can be built just outside your borders
Gain control over [all] tiles in a [1]-tile radius
Will not be replaced by automated units

name: Chateau
uniques: Can only be built on [Land] tiles <with [1] to [6] neighboring [Luxury resource] tiles>
Cannot be built on [Land] tiles <with [1] to [6] neighboring [Chateau] tiles>

name: Feitoria
uniques: Can only be built on [Coastal] tiles

name: Amusement Park
uniques: Can only be built on [Fresh water] tiles
Tile provides yield without assigned population
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+40 Gold]
Will not be replaced by automated units

name: Triangular Trade Route
uniques: [+2 Gold] for each adjacent [resource] <before the [Modern era]>

uniques: Tile provides yield without assigned population
